error.overlaps_existing_entry: Another entry already reads this device's messages. An entry with device ID + reads every device with its topic prefix, so it can't be added next to an entry for a single device with the same prefix.

user.title: Hildebrand Glow IHD Integration
user.description: Configuring the Hildebrand Glow IHD Integration.

data_description.device_id: Leave as + to detect every Glow device publishing to your MQTT broker. To read one device only, enter its ID from its topics, e.g. AABBCCDDEEFF in glow/AABBCCDDEEFF/STATE.
data_description.topic_prefix: The first part of the device's MQTT topics. Leave as glow unless you changed it on the device.
data_description.time_zone_electricity: The time zone the electricity meter's daily totals reset in.
data_description.time_zone_gas: The time zone the gas meter's daily totals reset in. Some gas meters reset at midnight UTC, if yours does choose UTC.

no_messages.title: No messages from a Glow device
no_messages.description:
{title} hasn't received any messages on {topic} in the {minutes} minutes since it was set up, so it has no sensors.

Check that the Glow device is publishing to your MQTT broker, and that the entry's device ID and topic prefix match its topics. You can change them with Reconfigure on the integration's page. This issue goes away when a message arrives.
